2610.06814.title: TAPDreamer: Transferable Adversarial Patches for World Action Models
2610.06814.paper_summary: World models learn to predict how their environment will evolve, making them an important foundation for general-purpose robotic control. Yet world action models depend on camera inputs whose manipulation can corrupt the visual representations used across tasks and action policies. Existing attacks on these models optimize against the victim's actions or predicted futures and therefore require access to target-model outputs. In this paper, we propose an attack, TAPDreamer, against world action models that instead uses a public encoder alone to construct a fixed local perturbation that transfers across tasks and action architectures. TAPDreamer requires no target-policy queries. Our key insight is that interactions between patch-induced changes in attention weights and value vectors broadcast a nearly identical representation shift far beyond the patch footprint, and this shift remains stable across task observations. Guided by this insight, TAPDreamer uses six frames from one source task to maximize the global L1 distance between clean and patched encoder representations. In closed-loop evaluation, one frozen patch per benchmark, covering about 6.5% of the input, reduces FastWAM's success rate from 97.7% to 0.0% across 40 LIBERO tasks and from 90.8% to 0.0% across 50 RoboTwin tasks; matched random patches retain 81.5% and 79.2% success. The same patches reduce success to 2.1% and 0.8% on two DreamWAM configurations and to 10.0% on Motus. These results show that protecting downstream action generation alone is insufficient: defenses for world action models must also secure shared visual encoders against persistent local perturbations.
2610.06814.paper_summary_zh: 世界模型學習預測其環境將如何演變，使其成為通用機器人控制的重要基礎。<lb/>然而，世界行動模型依賴於相機輸入，其操控可能會破壞用於各種任務和行動政策的視覺表示。<lb/>現有對這些模型的攻擊針對受害者的行動或預測未來進行優化，因此需要訪問目標模型的輸出。<lb/>在本文中，我們提出了一種攻擊方法，TAPDreamer，針對世界行動模型，該方法僅使用公共編碼器來構建一個固定的局部擾動，該擾動可以在不同任務和行動架構之間轉移。<lb/>TAPDreamer 不需要目標政策查詢。<lb/>我們的關鍵見解是，補丁引起的注意權重和價值向量之間的互動廣播出幾乎相同的表示轉變，這種轉變超出了補丁的影響範圍，並且在任務觀察中保持穩定。<lb/>在這一見解的指導下，TAPDreamer 使用來自一個源任務的六幀來最大化乾淨和補丁編碼器表示之間的全局 L1 距離。<lb/>在閉環評估中，每個基準一個固定的補丁，覆蓋約 6.5% 的輸入，將 FastWAM 的成功率從 97.7% 降低到 0.0%，在 40 個 LIBERO 任務中，並在 50 個 RoboTwin 任務中從 90.8% 降低到 0.0%；匹配的隨機補丁保持 81.5% 和 79.2% 的成功率。<lb/>相同的補丁在兩個 DreamWAM 配置上將成功率降低到 2.1% 和 0.8%，在 Motus 上降低到 10.0%。<lb/>這些結果顯示，僅保護下游行動生成是不夠的：世界行動模型的防禦還必須保護共享的視覺編碼器，抵禦持久的局部擾動。
